business_summary: Namyue Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the processing and sale of semi-finished and finished leather. It is also involved in the processing of cowhides; subcontracted leather processing activities; and trading leather. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Tannery Limited and changed its name to Namyue Holdings Limited in July 2022. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. Namyue Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Nam Yue (Group) Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자지주회사인 Namyue Holdings Limited는 가죽 반제품 및 완성품 가공 및 판매를 담당하고 있습니다. 또한 소가죽 가공에도 관여합니다. 하청 가죽 가공 활동; 그리고 가죽 거래. 이 회사는 이전에 Guangdong Tannery Limited로 알려졌으며 2022년 7월에 Namyue Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1995년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 센트럴에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Namyue Holdings Limited는 Nam Yue (Group) Company Limited의 자회사입니다.
